cropHealthCandidateTasks.title: Remove affected crop residues
cropHealthCandidateTasks.description: Remove visibly affected crop residues from the field before planting.

cropHealthGuidance.cropHealthObservation: Brown lesions were observed on the submitted crop image.

prePlantingActions: Remove visibly affected crop residues from the field before planting.
